title: Engineering for Huron Facility Renovation
short_description: County seeks architectural and engineering services for facility renovation and construction projects.
project_scope: Professional architectural and engineering services for county facility repair, renovation, replacement, energy conservation, sustainment, additions, remodeling, modification, and construction projects. Scope includes investigations, assessments, reports, plans, specifications, cost estimates, schedules, and construction administration. No specific building sizes, areas, or structural spans are stated.
services: Architectural services, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, cost estimating, investigative services, design services, assessments, reporting, plans and specifications, scheduling, and construction administration.
relevance_explanation:

- No bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or architecturally ambitious building is identified.
- Includes architecture and engineering services, but scope is broad and unspecific.

construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. Because the notice is for broad on-call professional services across multiple county facility projects over 36 months, a realistic sbp fee estimate cannot be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Bidders are sought for professional architectural and engineering services.
